g.text: Terminator has a global shutdown signal. All actors

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: are connected to the terminator such that they only

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: perform their jobs until the global shutdown signal

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: is activated. When the signal is activated, the

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: actors are expected to finish their jobs gracefully.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Each actor is also connected to the terminator such

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that they can activate the global shutdown signal.

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Intent is that the whole program's graceful shutdown

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: can be initiated by any of the essential actors in

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
